replies.author: sfkwww
replies.body: I think the monuments are a bit to close to spawn. It's also very plain, like you can't really do anything, theres no armor, no iron, no water, and no wood. It seems like a map that can get stalemated very easily.
replies.body_tagged: I think the monuments are a bit to close to spawn. It's also very plain, like you can't really do anything, theres no armor, no iron, no water, and no wood. It seems like a map that can get stalemated very easily.

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
I put the monuments a little closer to spawn so its not too easy to get the objective. As for iron and water I thought about them but did not end up going with them. I might add them in the future depending how this version plays.

I will take your feedback into consideration.
